headline: Mirum's Q2 Earnings Lag Estimates, Revenues Beat, 2026 View Raised
summary: MIRM Q2 earnings miss estimates while revenues beat the same, as Livmarli and bile acid drugs fuel growth, prompting a higher 2026 sales outlook.
